newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bangkok to Brussels for three-wheeled Belgian.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok to Brussels for three-wheeled Belgian.

text.p: A 32-year-old Belgian has begun a 10,000 km (6,000-mile) trip from Bangkok to Brussels by "tuk-tuk", a three-wheeled Thai taxi.
Axel Ewbank left Bangkok on Sunday, accompanied by his dog, and is due back in Brussels early next summer, his cousin Patrick Ewbank said on Monday.
The trip by "tuk-tuk", which gets its name from the sound generated by its small two-stroke engine, will carry the Belgian through Malaysia, Bangladesh, India, the Middle East and Europe.
